title: Freelance Designer Template Pack
description: A bilingual digital template pack for freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region, designed to help manage client projects, invoices, and revisions efficiently.
bullets: Digital template pack for project tracking, invoice management, and revision rounds in Notion and Google Sheets
Built for local freelancing habits in Arabic and English
No subscriptions, no client data collected
Simple and easy to use for multiple clients
